name: ROSEBUD Collaboration
notes: No roster or member count was found; the Atlas records no memberships. The 2011 talk lists 17 people from Zaragoza and Orsay.

summary.plain: The Spanish-French team that ran ROSEBUD, ultra-cold crystal detectors in the Canfranc underground laboratory in the Pyrenees, to search for dark matter.
summary.technical: Nuclear and Astroparticle Physics group (GIFNA, formerly LFNAE) of the University of Zaragoza, Spain, and the Institut d'Astrophysique Spatiale (IAS), Orsay, France (named 'The ROSEBUD Collaboration' in the 2011 talk). It later joined the EURECA project (not recorded: not built).
